Hi Sophie  great conversation today, thanks for the time. Per our discovery call, attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and an initial SOW for review. Key asks below: 

- Goal: Align on milestones, responsibilities, and the target close / procurement signature deadline so we can lock in Dedicated capacity and pricing.
- Proposed target close (contract signature): 2026-03-31. Given procurement cycles you mentioned, please confirm if your internal signature deadline needs to be earlier.
- Milestones in the draft: 
  1) Pilot kickoff (integration kickoff)  target 2026-03-08  Owner: FintechCo (implementation contact) + Redwood SE
  2) Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence review  target 2026-03-10  Owner: FintechCo (security) + Redwood security lead
  3) Procurement review & redlines complete  target 2026-03-24  Owner: FintechCo procurement + Redwood legal
  4) Contract signature & SOW execution  target 2026-03-31  Owner: FintechCo exec + Redwood sales

Dependencies: procurement approval, SOC2 evidence turnaround, and a short integration window for their engineering team.

Next steps I propose: you confirm the procurement signature deadline and any hard constraints on the target close date, and well update the MAP and issue a DocuSign packet. 

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_draft_v2.pdf, SOW_fintechco_v1.docx

Thanks,
